name: Bulk Menu Reorder
author: hellosabrinamok

sections.description:
Bulk Menu Reorder simplifies the process of managing navigation menus in WordPress by allowing users to reorder multiple menu items at once. Designed for websites with complex menus, this plugin saves time and improves efficiency.

Features:
– Bulk reordering of menu items.
– Easy-to-use interface in the WordPress Admin Dashboard.
– Compatibility with most WordPress themes.

Whether you have a large e-commerce site or a blog with multiple menus, Bulk Menu Reorder helps you keep your navigation organized with ease.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bulk-menu-reorder directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Appearance > Menus to start reordering menu items.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any theme that supports WordPress navigation menus.

Can I undo changes made to my menu?

Yes, changes to menu order can be undone by manually reordering items or restoring a previous backup.

Does this plugin support multisite?

Currently, the plugin supports single-site installations. Multisite compatibility will be added in future updates.
